arxiv-2206-03303.title: Magnetar Engines in Fast Blue Optical Transients and Their Connections with SLSNe, SNe Ic-BL, and lGRBs
arxiv-2206-03303.creator: Jian-Feng Liu, Jin-Ping Zhu, Liang-Duan Liu, Yun-Wei Yu, Bing Zhang
arxiv-2206-03303.description: Abstract We fit the multi-band lightcurves of 40 fast blue optical transients (FBOTs) with the magnetar engine model. The mass of the FBOT ejecta, the initial spin period and polar magnetic field of the FBOT magnetars are respectively constrained to M ej = 0.11 − 0.09 + 0.22 ​ M ⊙ M_{\rm{ej}}=0.11^{+0.22}_{-0.09}\,M_{\odot} , P i = 9.1 − 4.

arxiv-2502-11224.title: An introduction to local tropicalization
arxiv-2502-11224.creator: Patrick Popescu-Pampu and Dmitry Stepanov
arxiv-2502-11224.description: Abstract . In this paper we explain four viewpoints on the local tropicalization of formal subgerms of toric germs, which is a local analog of the global tropicalization of subvarieties of algebraic tori. We start by illustrating some of those viewpoints for plane curve singularities, then we pass to arbitrary dimensions.

arxiv-2510-09673.title: Cybersecurity Competence for Organisations in Inner Scandinavia
arxiv-2510-09673.creator: Simone Fischer-Hübner, Leonardo A. Martucci, Lejla Islami, Ala Sarah Alaqra and Farzaneh Karegar
arxiv-2510-09673.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Simone Fischer-Hübner, Leonardo A. Martucci, Lejla Islami, Ala Sarah Alaqra and Farzaneh Karegar. A rapidly growing number of cybersecurity threats and incidents demands that Swedish organisations increase their efforts to improve their cybersecurity capacities. This paper presents results from interviews and a prior survey with key representatives from enterprises and public sector organisations in the Swedish region of Värmland in Inner Scandinavia, examining their cybersecurity readiness and needs for education and competence development.

doe-osti-3374032-comprehensive-integrate.title: Comprehensive Integrated Simulation Methodology for Enabling Near-Zero Emission Heavy-Duty Vehicles
doe-osti-3374032-comprehensive-integrate.creator: Strzelec, Andrea, Trujillo, Mario F., Wahiduzzaman, Syed et al.
doe-osti-3374032-comprehensive-integrate.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This project developed and validated an integrated reduced-dimensional simulation methodology for a modern heavy-duty diesel engine and its aftertreatment system. The team built physics-based models for in-cylinder combustion, exhaust gas dynamics, DOC, DPF, SCR, and ASC behavior

pmc-10609053.creator: Magdalena Kędzierska, Magdalena Bańkosz, Katarzyna Sala, Julia Dudzik, Piotr Potemski, Bożena Tyliszczak, Traian V Chirila, Matthias Schnabelrauch

pmc-10769948.title: Use of the sun compass by monocularly occluded homing pigeons in a food localisation task in an outdoor arena
pmc-10769948.creator: Sara Cioccarelli, Benedetta Bianchi, Dimitri Giunchi, Anna Gagliardo
pmc-10769948.description: Functional asymmetries of the avian visual system can be studied in monocularly occluded birds, as their hemispheres are largely independent. Right and left monocularly occluded homing pigeons and control birds under binocular view have been trained in a food localisation task in an octagonal outdoor arena provided with one coloured beacon on each wall.

pmc-12559334.title: Early-life endurance sports lowers frailty and falls in former male athletes
pmc-12559334.creator: Keziban Gamze Bas, Rabia Hürrem Ozdurak Singin, Tuba Denizci
pmc-12559334.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The long-term impact of professional endurance sports on frailty and fall risk in older age remains underexplored. This study examined frailty, physical activity (PA), and health outcomes in older men with and without a history of professional endurance sports. We assessed 200 men aged 60–85 years, 100 former professional endurance athletes (For-A) with ≥ 5 years of competitive experience and 100 age-matched non-athletes (Non-A).

pmc-12577910.title: Teaching surgeons to question the evidence: should surgical meta-research be embedded early in undergraduate and residency training?
pmc-12577910.creator: Franklin Kevin Ruiz-Gutiérrez, Johana Galván-Barrios, Kevin Fernando Montoya Quintero, Alexis Rafael Narvaez-Rojas
pmc-12577910.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). lated to surgical evidence[1]. An updated Scopus search of surgical meta-research (Combination of terms with TITLE or TITLE-ABS tags: MeSH Unique ID: D000098346; MeSH Unique ID: D013514) retrieved 664 articles published between 1958 and May 2025. Production rose from a mean of 13 papers per year (2005–09) to 35 per year (2020–24); the last 5 years alone contributed 171 publications (26%), underscoring that surgical meta-research has matured into a vibrant methodological field that warrants early educational adoption.

pmc-12659339.title: Implementing ocular treatment with pencil beam scanning: the FHCC experience
pmc-12659339.creator: Jatinder Saini, Andrew Stacey, Alexander Egan, Rajesh Regmi, Charles Bloch, Marco Schwarz, Ramesh Rengan, Jonathan Chen, Lia Halasz
pmc-12659339.description: BackgroundThe Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center (FHCC) has developed a novel in-house method for ocular proton therapy by adapting a pencil beam scanning (PBS) beamline and using a commercial treatment planning system. This manuscript outlines the workflow from simulation to treatment delivery and presents our experiences with the initial 40 patients.

pmc-13146483.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2339 EXPERIENCE FROM A PORTUGUESE TERTIARY HOSPITAL IN ISOLATED POSTERIOR CEREBRAL ARTERY OCCLUSION: MEDICAL MANAGEMENT OR ENDOVASCULAR THERAPY
pmc-13146483.creator: Stefanie Moreira, Joana Lopes, Mariana Gomes, Sofia Xavier, Jose Amorim, Angelo Carneiro, Ana Rita Paiva Silva, José Nuno Alves, Carla Ferreira
pmc-13146483.description: Background and aimsManagement of acute ischemic stroke due to posterior cerebral artery (PCA) occlusion remains uncertain, particularly regarding the role of endovascular therapy (EVT). We aimed to compare clinical and functional outcomes between patients treated with medical management (MM) or EVT and to assess complications.MethodsRetrospective, single-center-study including isolated PCA occlusion admitted within 24hours of time last seen well between January/2020-June/2025.

pmc-13292731.title: Catcher Domains as Multifunctional Fusion Modules for Soluble Expression, Covalent Coupling, and Spatial Organization of Recombinant Proteins
pmc-13292731.creator: Ruxia Fan, Xing Wan, Safoorah Khanum, Juhani P. Jokio, Nea B. Möttönen, Miia R. Mäkelä, A. Sesilja Aranko
pmc-13292731.description: Fusion tags are essential tools for recombinant protein production, but their functions are often limited to improving solubility or facilitating purification. Catcher domains are split‐protein fragments derived from bacterial adhesion proteins that spontaneously form irreversible isopeptide bonds with their complementary Tag.

pmc-13335362.title: Rare pediatric multi-system thrombosis post-COVID-19: a three-year follow-up case report and narrative review on rivaroxaban for long-term management
pmc-13335362.creator: Shiyi Zhu, Xiaozhong Li, Ruyue Chen, Shuang Wu, Lu Jiang, Mengxia Li, Luyao Huang, Ningxun Cui
pmc-13335362.description: This retrospective study presents a 10-year-old male with multi-systemic venous thromboembolism (VTE) secondary to COVID-19, including right ventricular thrombus(40 mm × 18 mm), bilateral iliac vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and renal vein thrombosis. The child presented with fever, abdominal pain, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP 222.72 mg/L, WBC 22.41 × 10⁹/L).
